input: I've been a salaried backend developer for six years. I have eleven months of savings, two long-term clients who have asked me to freelance for them, and a mortgage. I keep thinking about handing in my notice.
reworded_input: Six years into a salaried backend job, I'm sitting on eleven months of runway, two clients who want to hire me directly, and a mortgage. Quitting is on my mind.
notes: Runway is grounded in months, not currency; a branch quoting a rupee figure is hallucinating.
